questions.prompt: What is the output of `1..10 | Where-Object { $_ % 2 -eq 0 }`?
Does `Where-Object` change the .NET object type flowing through the pipeline?

options.a: No — it filters items; object type is preserved
options.b: Yes — it converts all items to String
options.c: Yes — it converts all items to PSCustomObject

questions.prompt: What does `$_` (or `$PSItem`) refer to inside a `Where-Object` script block?

options.a: The current pipeline object being evaluated
options.b: The first item in the array
